data.query:
customEvents
| where name in ('upload_started', 'upload_completed', 'upload_failed')
| summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 1h), name
data.title: Upload events over time (24h)

data.query:
customEvents
| where name in ('upload_started', 'upload_completed')
| summarize started = count_if(name == 'upload_started'), completed = count_if(name == 'upload_completed')
| extend successRate = 100.0 * completed / max(started, 1)
| project successRate
data.title: Upload success rate % (24h)
